key.name: previous-state
key.description: Whether to restore the system screen keyboard setting that was active before the extension forced it on.

key.name: native-capable-apps
key.summary: Apps observed opening the keyboard natively
key.description: Application IDs seen summoning the on-screen keyboard through the native stack. Forced opens are skipped for these. Managed automatically; inspect with gsettings.

key.name: click-only-apps
key.description: Application IDs whose focus changes are usually preceded by a pointer press. Bare focus changes do not open the keyboard for these. Managed automatically.

key.name: force-immediate-apps
key.summary: Apps forced open without the fallback wait
key.description: Application IDs proven to lack native keyboard support over several focus episodes. Bare focus changes open the keyboard at once for these. Managed automatically.
